voiceSpike.title: Voice spike
voiceSpike.intro: Hold the button or the space bar, say one procedure command, then let go. This measures the time from releasing the button to the proposal on screen.
voiceSpike.notice: Development only. Nothing is saved, and confirming does not run the command.
voiceSpike.micBlocked: Microphone access was refused. Allow it in the browser and reload.
voiceSpike.activeToothHint: Lets you test a command that leaves out the tooth, for example "add a crown".
voiceSpike.confirmed: Confirmed (not executed: this is the spike)
voiceSpike.target: Target: under 2,000 ms at the 95th percentile
voiceSpike.interpreterHint: The language model that turns the transcript into a command. Each attempt uses the one selected when you start speaking.
voiceSpike.interpreterWaiting: Waiting for the server to list its interpreters…

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use your clinic account.
auth.chooseClinicHint: Your account belongs to more than one clinic.
auth.codeHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Dental Platform.
auth.enrollHint: Your role needs a second step at sign-in. Scan this code with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
auth.enrollManual: Can't scan? Enter this key instead:

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
errors.challengeExpired: The sign-in took too long. Please start again.
errors.noClinic: Your account has no access to a clinic. Ask your clinic administrator.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidInput: Check the email and password and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

shell.comingSoon: Sessions, charting and treatment arrive in the next milestones.

patients.title: Patients
patients.searchHint: Type at least 2 characters. Misspelt names still match.
patients.nationalIdHint: Stored encrypted; only the last characters are shown.
patients.nationalIdReplace: Type a new number to replace it
patients.duplicateTitle: This patient may already be registered
patients.duplicateHint: Open the existing record if it is the same person. Register anyway only if it is not.
patients.archiveConfirm: Archive this patient? They will no longer appear in search. Nothing is deleted.
patients.conflict: Someone else changed this patient. The latest details are shown; check them and make your change again.
patients.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
